items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: So that’s my wife Gina Funes. We’ve been married going on 58 years, okay. And so we were starting to work shows together after I left the yacht club.

ctx.x: Well this is so — I’m playing in the East Bay in a night club, and they were booking acts like Frank Sinatra Jr., Leslie Ugg — I mean Dorothy Dandridge — my phone — and a group called The Lancers, and it was a vocal quartet. They had done a lot of T.V. They were with Kay Starr. Made some hit records. And they were headlining at Harrah’s in Tahoe, in Nevada. They were the headlining act. And in those days Bill Harrah — the lounges were very important. And they would have junkets for gamblers to go up from the Bay…

Seattle you call me, I’ll hire you.” Because he had a band that worked five nights a week. So I had her phone number and called her up, and she says, “I’m serious,” she said, “it’s funny you should call, Fred, I’m looking for a band to start next week. How would you like a year contract?” I said, “Really? Okay you got it.” I said, “I’ll be there.” So I called the best musicians in Seattle, which are really good player, a rhythm section. I get in my car and I’m thinking Jesus, I need a place to stay, I didn’t…
